timeline.heading: Since 1990
timeline._comment: One entry per milestone. Keep entries factual: year + what happened.

items.event: Founded in Dobrich. First production run; the company enters the Bulgarian furniture market.
Cabinet furniture launched and a dedicated production base acquired.
Major production facility acquired; manufacturing infrastructure scaled.
Reorganised as the GS Group; European modernisation projects launched.
Scaled export operations as an OEM supplier to European furniture brands.

people.heading: Ownership and management
people.body: The company has been family-owned since 1990 and the second generation now runs operations. Three people represent it to clients — ownership, management and production. Their names, responsibilities and working languages are on the leadership page.
